packageRules.description: No automerge here, overriding the shared preset. The preset's automerge rules state their own precondition out loud — 'automerge assumes the consuming repo gates merges on required status checks' — and this repo has no PR-triggered workflow at all. Renovate reads a branch with no checks as green, so automerge would mean merging a dependency bump with nothing having run. Placed last deliberately: Renovate applies packageRules in order and later matches win, and because vulnerabilityAlerts is layered on top of the RESOLVED config, a trailing rule like this one is also the only form that reaches security updates. Delete this rule once the repo has a PR gate.
